title: Living in a new country
subtitle: 「在新國家生活／海外定居／在另一國居住」，究竟是哪一種？

falseSynonyms.word: living in a new country / moving abroad
falseSynonyms.zh: moving abroad 是搬遷動作／過程；living in a new country 是搬到之後的持續生活狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They are moving abroad next month. They have been living abroad for three years.

falseSynonyms.word: living in a new country / travelling abroad
falseSynonyms.zh: travelling abroad 通常是短期旅行，不代表建立日常居住生活。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She travelled abroad for two weeks. She lived abroad for two years.

falseSynonyms.word: living in a new country / visiting another country
falseSynonyms.zh: visiting 是暫時停留；living 通常表示以當地為生活基地。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is visiting another country for a conference. He is living in another country for work.

falseSynonyms.word: living in a new country / settling abroad
falseSynonyms.zh: settling abroad 多了一層「安頓、建立生活」的過程與長期感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is living abroad for six months. They are settling abroad and looking for a permanent home.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者意思接近；residing abroad 更正式、行政或法律化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is living abroad this year. Citizens residing abroad must update their address.

falseSynonyms.zh: immigrating 是移入另一國並建立居留的遷移過程；living abroad 不必涉及永久移民身份。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They are immigrating to Canada. They are living abroad on a two-year work assignment.

falseSynonyms.zh: expatriate 指人或身份標籤，不是單純生活狀態；而且並非所有海外居民都使用這個標籤。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is an expatriate working in Dubai. She has been living abroad for several years.

falseSynonyms.zh: reside 是動詞；resident 是名詞／形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She resides abroad. She is a resident of the city.
